rules.name: rrr-position-keys-cfs
rules.sql: WITH ten AS (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1), pos AS ( SELECT upper(split_part(c.contract_number, '_', 1)) AS client_code, upper(trim(c.product_code)) AS product_key, CASE WHEN c.fixing_date IS NOT NULL AND c.fixing_date <= :cob THEN c.fixing_date ELSE CAST(:cob AS date) END AS rate_date, c.mtm_usd, c.mtm_nc FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM ten) AND c.business_unit = :bu AND c.value_date = :valueDate AND c.derivative_type = 'fx_forward_ndf' AND c.contract_number IS NOT NULL AND upper(split_part(c.contract_number, '_', 1)) IN ('GBS', 'SBC', 'SOR', 'SFX', 'OGB', 'GBX', 'SBX') ) SELECT pos.client_code, pos.product_key, pos.rate_date, COUNT(*) AS n_positions, ROUND(SUM(pos.mtm_nc)::numeric, 2) AS sum_mtm_nc, MAX(p.invenio_product_code) AS product_master_code, MAX(p.currency) AS product_currency, MAX(m.spot) AS spot_id, MAX(m.quantotype) AS quantotype, MAX(u.settle_value) AS rate_found, MAX(u.settlement_date) AS rate_settlement_date FROM pos LEFT JOIN opera.product_master_table p ON p.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM ten) AND replace(upper(trim(p.invenio_product_code)), 'CR ', '') = pos.product_key AND upper(trim(p.invenio_product_code)) LIKE 'CR %' LEFT JOIN opera.currency_spot_mapping_table m ON m.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM ten) AND upper(trim(m.currency)) = upper(trim(p.currency)) LEFT JOIN opera.underlying_settle_value_table u ON u.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM ten) AND u.underlying_id = m.spot AND u.settlement_date = pos.rate_date GROUP BY pos.client_code, pos.product_key, pos.rate_date ORDER BY pos.client_code, pos.rate_date

SELECT upper(p.client_code) AS client_code, p.derivative_type, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, ROUND(SUM(p.mtm_usd)::numeric, 2) AS sum_mtm_usd, ROUND(SUM(p.mtm_nc)::numeric, 2) AS sum_mtm_nc FROM opera.fn_client_statement_position_rows_v2( (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1), CAST(:bu AS text), CAST(:valueDate AS date), (SELECT jsonb_agg(m.client_code) FROM opera.client_master_data m WHERE m.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND m.business_unit = :bu AND length(trim(m.client_code)) = 3)) p WHERE p.contract_number IS NULL OR trim(p.contract_number) = '' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY ABS(SUM(p.mtm_usd)) DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT upper(p.client_code) AS client_code_column, upper(split_part(p.contract_number, '_', 1)) AS contract_prefix, p.derivative_type, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, ROUND(SUM(p.mtm_usd)::numeric, 2) AS sum_mtm_usd, MIN(p.contract_number) AS example_contract FROM opera.fn_client_statement_position_rows_v2( (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1), CAST(:bu AS text), CAST(:valueDate AS date), (SELECT jsonb_agg(m.client_code) FROM opera.client_master_data m WHERE m.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND m.business_unit = :bu AND length(trim(m.client_code)) = 3)) p WHERE p.contract_number IS NOT NULL AND trim(p.contract_number) <> '' AND upper(coalesce(p.client_code, '')) <> upper(split_part(p.contract_number, '_', 1)) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY ABS(SUM(p.mtm_usd)) DESC LIMIT 100
